chapters.title: The vision of Christ
chapters.summary: Exiled on Patmos, John sees the risen Christ among seven golden lampstands, glorious and fearsome: I am the Alpha and Omega, the first and the last.

chapters.title: Letters to four churches
chapters.summary: Christ speaks to Ephesus, which left its first love, suffering Smyrna, compromising Pergamum and Thyatira. Be faithful unto death, and I will give you a crown of life.

chapters.title: Letters to three churches
chapters.summary: Christ speaks to dead Sardis, faithful Philadelphia and lukewarm Laodicea. Behold, I stand at the door and knock.

chapters.title: The throne in heaven
chapters.summary: John sees God's throne surrounded by a rainbow, elders and living creatures crying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty. You are worthy, for You created all things.

chapters.title: The Lamb and the scroll
chapters.summary: No one can open the sealed scroll, until the Lamb who was slain takes it. Heaven sings: worthy is the Lamb, who redeemed people from every nation.

chapters.title: The first six seals
chapters.summary: The Lamb opens the seals: horsemen bring conquest, war, famine and death. Martyrs cry out, and the sky is shaken.

chapters.title: A great multitude
chapters.summary: God's servants are sealed. John sees a great multitude from every nation before the throne. God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.

chapters.title: The seventh seal
chapters.summary: Silence in heaven for half an hour. The prayers of the saints rise like incense, and four trumpets bring judgment on the earth.

chapters.title: Locusts and horsemen
chapters.summary: The fifth and sixth trumpets bring terrible locusts and a vast army, yet the survivors still do not repent.

chapters.title: The little scroll
chapters.summary: A mighty angel holds a little scroll. John eats it: sweet in his mouth, bitter in his stomach. He must prophesy again.

chapters.title: Two witnesses
chapters.summary: Two witnesses prophesy, are killed, and are raised. The seventh trumpet sounds: the kingdoms of this world have become the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ.

chapters.title: The woman and the dragon
chapters.summary: A woman gives birth to a child who will rule the nations. The dragon is cast out of heaven, and the believers overcome him by the blood of the Lamb.

chapters.title: Two beasts
chapters.summary: A beast rises from the sea and receives worship, and a second beast forces everyone to take its mark. This calls for endurance and faith.

chapters.title: The Lamb on Mount Zion
chapters.summary: The Lamb stands with His people on Mount Zion. Angels proclaim the everlasting gospel. Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord.

chapters.title: The song of Moses and the Lamb
chapters.summary: Those who overcame the beast sing: great and marvelous are Your works, Lord God Almighty.

chapters.title: Seven bowls
chapters.summary: Seven angels pour out bowls of God's wrath on the earth. Behold, I come as a thief.

chapters.title: The great prostitute
chapters.summary: Babylon is pictured as a prostitute riding a beast, drunk with the blood of the saints. The Lamb will overcome, for He is Lord of lords and King of kings.

chapters.title: Babylon falls
chapters.summary: Babylon the great is fallen. Kings and merchants weep over the city's ruin, while heaven rejoices. Come out of her, my people.

chapters.title: The rider on the white horse
chapters.summary: Heaven sings Hallelujah at the marriage supper of the Lamb. Christ rides out on a white horse, Faithful and True, the Word of God, and defeats the beast.

chapters.title: The thousand years
chapters.summary: Satan is bound for a thousand years, then released and defeated forever. The dead are judged before a great white throne.

chapters.title: All things new
chapters.summary: John sees a new heaven and a new earth and the holy city coming down. God will dwell with His people; there will be no more death or crying. Behold, I make all things new.

chapters.title: Come, Lord Jesus
chapters.summary: The river of life flows from the throne, and the tree of life heals the nations. There will be no night there. Behold, I come quickly. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.
